dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low spatial density of solid high-intensity pixel clusters. Small, localized spots lacking internal gradients are visible near the dorsal peak and within the core of the anterior-most annular patterns.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the four largest posterior annuli form an irregular quadrilateral.
